title: Puriyaadha Pudhir
desc: Escaped convict Raghu unknowingly seeks refuge in his college friend Geetha's home. Complications arise swiftly when he makes a shocking discovery of a hidden corpse.

title: Naalaiya Theerpu
desc: Arun, who has many extra-marital affairs, molests his wife, Mahalakshmi. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets pregnant and has a son.

title: Naan Sivappu Manithan
desc: A Tamil professor and his friend try to stop the prostitution and illicit liquor trade in their neighbourhood. However, due to their work, a criminal gang begins to attack their families.

title: Super Kudumbam
desc: Arun pretends to be married in order to get a house for rent. He picks Shanthi, an uncouth slum girl, to act as his wife. Eventually, circumstances change and they get actually married.

title: Aai
desc: A military officer cripples his arch-enemy for killing his friend and escapes with his sister. He sets out to fight against this gangster when he comes to kill his friend's sister.
